$comment: Checked-in, shared settings. Machine-specific entries belong in
permissions.allow lists the exact commands AGENTS.md mandates, by full
path. Deliberately NOT Bash(python3:*) or Bash(node:*): the point is that
the sanctioned checks run without friction while an ad-hoc script still
prompts, because an ad-hoc script is where an unreviewed action hides.
CHANGELOG.md is 'ask' rather than 'deny'. Deny outranks allow from every
scope including a maintainer's own local settings, and the maintainer
writes every CHANGELOG entry — a deny here would block the one person
entitled to edit it, and lifting it would mean editing a tracked file and
dirtying the tree. 'ask' is unforgeable by the model and liftable per
invocation, which is the behaviour actually wanted.
